columns.thing: where it is on the screen and what it looks like
columns.screen: the words on the screen that name it (a label, a button, a tooltip), quoted; null when no label names it
columns.his_word: the word the user says for it, from his own messages and the spoken commands, with the date he said it; null when he has none yet
columns.code_today: the words the code says for it now; each has to be in the code, or the row is stale
columns.code_word: the one word the code is to say for it; null while unruled
columns.status: ruled: his word, given where `ruled` says | his_word: a word he has used, not yet the code's everywhere | agreed: screen, user and code already say one word | unruled: no word of his yet, the row waits for him | kept: a name from outside this app, or a thing he has no word for, so the code keeps its own
columns.retired: code words for it that are gone and stay gone; `keep` lists the tokens that may still carry the letters (another thing's name, or something stored on disk)
